title.quote: Explaining Graph Neural Networks Using Interpretable Local Surrogates

extractions.description: This paper proposes an interpretable local surrogate (ILS) method for understanding predictions made by black-box graph neural network models. The method uses simple surrogate models to approximate the behavior of black-box graph models near a specific input example, identifying the most relevant nodes impacting predictions. The paper highlights the effectiveness of the ILS method in providing enhanced interpretability over existing methods for graph explainability.
